༄༅/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrom mar zlar bos pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrom mar zlar bos pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bha ga wa ti ār+ya ta re/ bdag tā ra nā thas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'phags ma'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /nyes byas gang yin bshags par bgyi/ /nyes pa gang zhig legs pa dang*/ /de sbyong thabs dang lung bstan gsol/ /bu ni lam gol byung srid na/ /ma yis ci phyir lam mi ston/ / shu+u bhaṃ/ ༈ oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /bdag kun dga' snying po phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus sel bar shog /gal te bu la nus med na/ /yum gcig gtong grogs cis mi mdzad/ /gdung bas lhang lhang zhu zhing 'bod/ /ye shes spyan gyi mi gzigs sam/ / shu+u bhaṃ// ༈ ār+ya tā re/ kyai sems can thams cad sdug bsngal ya cha ma cha 'di 'dra rang 'khur dgos pa 'dra/ khyod kyi ci yi mi skyob lags/ a re/ kyai/ sgrol ma kyai sgrol mdzad ma/ tsan+d+ra go mi bzhin/ bdag kyang skyob par zhu/ he he/ ༈ tā re tā re tā re/ pur rgyal bod kyi mi rnams sdug bsngal 'di 'dras non/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nub pa 'di la khyod kyis skyob/ khyod min su la ram zla sgron/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig gzigs shig / ༈ phaṭa/ ma yi bu la khro ba ci/ /nyes pa thams cad snying nas bshags/ / lar nas thams cad bden pas stong*/ /phaṭa/ ༈ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha/ jo mo mngon par mtho ba'i yul/ /dman pa'i gnas las drangs du gsol/ di pa ཾ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ shākya shri bha dra bzhin/ /bdag gi co to nas zungs shig /tā re mkhyen/ / ༈ he bha ṭi/ bhā ṭi/ bha ṭi/ rnal 'byor ma can gyi dbang phyug mas/ /ma ma a yur tsi raṃ dzī ra/ khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so/ /yo gi shā ri/ / ༈ he de bī/ lha mo mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms/ /re sa gzhan na ma mchis so/ / maṅga laṃ// ༈ dpal ldan mi 'jigs phyag rgya de/ /bdag gi spyi bor rtag tu zhog / byin gyis rlobs shig e ma ho/ / ༈ bho bha ga wa tī/ ye shes gzi 'od rgyas pa yi/

/dngos grub de 'dra bdag la stsol/ ha ha ha ha/ ༈ aṃ aṃ aṃ/ shes rab mtshon chas sgrib gnyis 'joms/ /bdag cag ma rig da sol cig /sems can nyon mongs rgya mtshor bying*/ /'di 'dra 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /a la la te las la bzhengs/ / bkra shis/ / ༈ rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur ba mo/ khyed kyi bdag cag rig 'dzin gyi/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gnas la zhog /khams gsum dbang phyug go 'phang 'khod/ /kal+yaṇa/ / ༈ tāṃ khaṃ/ bdag kyang dam tshig rdo rje bsgrubs/ /'phags ma'i sku dang mnyam par shog /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun 'dus pa'i/ /dbang phyug ma dang bdag por gyur/ /sam+ban+na ku ru/ 'di rje btsun 'phags ma sgrom mar zlar bos pa zhes bya ba yin/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'o// //maṅga laṃ// bkra shis// ༈ 'dir 'bad dge 'dis lus 'di bor ma thag /g.yu lo bkod par 'phags ma'i dgyes zhal drung*/ / thugs sras gdul zhing mchog tu legs gyur te/ /skye srid de la lam mthar phyin gyur cig /ces pa'ang ma tis smras so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 4 - - PAGE 3 - -2 - - PAGE 2 - - PAGE 2 - - PAGE 2 -
